description: TexturePainting mutants paired with headless texture sampling, volume-placement, and cancellation contracts.

mutants.description: Drop the alpha-aware conversion for raw RGBA input, changing the byte stride and decoded color contract.
Ignore a valid per-face material-to-texture mapping so the second mapped face samples the wrong texture or fallback color.
Swap RGB baseColorFactor channels when a material has no usable texture.
Apply the recorded source mesh offset in the wrong direction, moving a replaced painted volume away from its original world placement.
Stop forwarding cancellation from the public face-color import API to the clustering pipeline.
